question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Anshima was __too exhausted to__ continue the race.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'No substitution required'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• The words "**too…to"** have a **negative meaning.**
 
• It means ‘more than is necessary or desirable (आवश्यकता से अधिक या वांछनीय)’. 
 
 
• *Example: He was **too nervous to** perform well on the stage.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
